document: Synthetic Departmental Office Orders and Circulars

records.subject: Notification of Comprehensive Examination boards for Odd Semester 2023-24 leftover cases
records.content: Supervisors shall propose Comprehensive Examination Boards on Form DP-08. A scholar may appear at most twice. Second failure shall be reported for termination under Clause 9.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/OO/2024/07 dated 2024-04-02. Subject: Comprehensive Examination boards. Clauses 9, 12.3. Form DP-08. Maximum two attempts.

records.subject: Roster-based allocation of Ph.D. supervisors and SRC constitution
records.content: New scholars shall file DP-12(a). Faculty shall confirm on DP-12(b). A Professor/Associate/Assistant Professor shall not supervise more than six Code-11 scholars at a time. SRC on DP-02 within one month of allotment.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/CIR/2024/03 dated 2024-01-12. Subject: supervisor roster and SRC. Clauses 12.1, 12.2. Forms DP-12a, DP-12b, DP-02. Cap of six Code-11 scholars.

records.subject: Similarity index limit for Ph.D. thesis submission
records.content: Thesis submission requires IPR Cell certificate on Form DP-14 with similarity index below 15%. GL-1 packing norms apply. DP-14 shall be bound with the thesis.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/OO/2024/11 dated 2024-05-20. Subject: plagiarism / similarity below 15%. Clause 13.1. Forms DP-14 and GL-1.

records.subject: Minimum SPI/CPI for continuation and fellowship
records.content: Minimum SPI/CPI for continuing in the Doctoral Programme is 6.5. Academically deficient scholars shall not receive stipend/fellowship under Clause 15.1(2).
records.text: CSED/DDPC/CIR/2023/18 dated 2023-08-14. Subject: SPI/CPI 6.5 and fellowship. Clauses 8, 15.1.

records.subject: Late registration of Ph.D. scholars
records.content: Late registration shall follow the Academic Calendar. Academic advising and DP-01 registration details must be completed. Unregistered scholars shall not be evaluated for the semester.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/OO/2023/22 dated 2023-09-04. Subject: late registration. Clauses 4.1, 4.2. Form DP-01.

records.subject: Leave rules for doctoral scholars
records.content: Leave shall be applied on Form DP-06 through the Supervisor and Convener DDPC. Absence without sanctioned leave is a misconduct under Clause 5.5.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/CIR/2024/06 dated 2024-03-01. Subject: leave rules. Clauses 5.1, 5.2, 5.5. Form DP-06.

records.subject: Open Seminar eligibility checklist
records.content: Open Seminar on Form DP-11 is permitted only if the scholar has passed all courses with no N/F grade, passed Comprehensive Examination and SOA Seminar, and earned minimum credits in Section 7.1.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/OO/2024/15 dated 2024-06-03. Subject: Open Seminar eligibility. Clauses 11, 7.1. Form DP-11.

records.subject: DDPC meeting notice cycle for AY 2024-25
records.content: DDPC shall meet at least twice every semester. Agenda notes must reach the Convener five working days in advance. Student members shall recuse from evaluation of their own cases.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/CIR/2024/09 dated 2024-07-08. Subject: DDPC meeting cycle. Clause 1.3. At least two meetings per semester.

records.subject: Change of registration from full-time to part-time
records.content: Requests shall be filed on Form DP-05 with Supervisor comments and employer NOC where applicable, for DDPC recommendation and SDPC approval.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/OO/2023/29 dated 2023-12-11. Subject: full-time to part-time. Clause 4.5. Form DP-05.

records.subject: Waiver procedure in special cases
records.content: Procedures other than Section 3.3 (Eligibility) and Section 8 (Academic Performance Requirement) may be waived by Chairperson Senate on DDPC and SDPC recommendation. All exceptions shall be reported to the Senate.
records.text: CSED/DDPC/CIR/2024/12 dated 2024-08-01. Subject: Clause 17 waiver procedure. Sections 3.3 and 8 cannot be waived.
